literal_source_claim: A complete orthogonal wavelet basis of L^2[0,1].

domain_and_universes: Expected domain is [0,1] with Lebesgue measure and codomain is R or C; the exact subtype/restricted-measure model, scalar field, and L2 representation remain open.
quantifiers: dyadic scale j in the source-selected range
translation k with the source-selected bounds at scale j
functions in the selected L^2 unit-interval space
hypotheses: the Haar scaling function and wavelets use the source-selected normalization
the interval, measure, scalar field, and almost-everywhere quotient conventions are fixed
conclusion: The selected scaling function and dyadic Haar wavelets form a complete orthonormal (Hilbert) basis of the selected L^2[0,1] space.
excluded_degenerate_cases: No claim about L^p for p != 2, R as the domain, multivariate Haar systems, general wavelets, unconditional bases, or pointwise convergence is included. Endpoint values on dyadic boundaries are immaterial only after an almost-everywhere transport is checked.
